cost_model.fee_note: Hong Kong stock approximation: broker commission plus HK stamp duty, SFC/AFRC levies, trading fee, and CCASS settlement fee; US SEC fee and TAF are not applied.

meta.selection_rule: 2026YTD is used only as final validation gate; ranking uses 2021-2025 training metrics.

split_adjustment.known_event: No known ICBC HK split adjustment was required for the requested 2021-2026 window; the cloud OHLC series is still checked for split-like discontinuities before backtesting.
split_adjustment.handling: No additional split adjustment was applied because no split-like discontinuity was detected in the cloud OHLC series.

meta.execution: Signal at T close, execution at T+1 open; final close forced at interval end.

Entry: 工商银行 close breaks prior 14d high/low. Filters: 工商银行 close above/below EMA120; 工商银行 ROC40 > 4%; 恒生指数 EMA150 filter; 恒生指数 ROC60 > -10%; 工商银行-恒生指数 ROC60 > 6%; ATR14% <= 3.0%. Exit: 90d opposite channel; take profit 12%.
